text: I understand you want to speak with someone who can help you right away. Let me transfer you to a human agent who can assist you with returning the E-Reader from order #W1679211 and getting your $244.02 refund to PayPal.
zh: 我理解您想立即和能帮助您的人交谈。让我转接一位人工客服，他们可以帮助您处理订单 #W1679211 中的电子阅读器退货，并将您的 $244.02 退款发到PayPal。
